Senseco Systems is an industry-leading, independent fire and security specialist. We’re experts in the design, supply, installation, commissioning and maintenance of fire, passive, sprinklers, suppression, voice, security, monitoring and integrated systems. Whilst we started working in London and the South East, we now have offices across the UK, offering an unrivalled level of expertise, technical competence and, above all, customer service. Plus, we’re proud to be the UK’s first CarbonNeutral-certified fire and security company.
